title: Compact Support Property of Super-Brownian Motion with Irregular Drift
summary: We study the one-dimensional stochastic partial differential equation \[ d_t X_t(x)=\frac{1}{2}ΔX_t(x) +b_1\unicode{x1D7D9}_{\{X_t(x)>0\}} +\sqrt{X_t(x)}\dot W(t,x), \] where $b_1>0$, $\dot W$ is space-time white noise, and the initial condition is a nonnegative, compactly supported continuous function. We prove that its unique weak solution has the compact support property. The drift term lies outside the usual regularity assumptions for the Dawson--Girsanov theorem.
